description: For \(r\ge1\), every nonempty structure with \(k\) unary predicates has a nonempty capped representative subset of size at most \(r2^k\), with matching profile capacities at \(r\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MonadicLogic.capped_representatives.{u_1} {k : ℕ} {M : Type u_1}
  [(Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MonadicLogic.lang k).Structure M] [Nonempty M] (r : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) :
  ∃ D,
    D.Nonempty ∧
      D.card ≤ r * 2 ^ k ∧
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MonadicLogic.Capped r Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MonadicLogic.profile D ∧
          Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MonadicLogic.Capacities r Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MonadicLogic.profile
            Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MonadicLogic.profile
